title: AI Security Review and Threat Triage for Business Teams

questions.question: What is the purpose of business threat triage for AI use cases?
options: To identify review triggers before rollout
To approve every AI tool locally
questions.explanation: Business triage makes risk visible early and routes cases to the right review path.

questions.question: Which signal usually requires explicit data-boundary discussion?
questions.explanation: Sensitive data needs a clear boundary before tools, prompts, or storage are approved.

questions.question: Why is untrusted input a security signal for AI systems?
options: It can carry manipulative or malicious instructions
questions.explanation: Untrusted input can include prompt injection or other abuse patterns.

questions.question: What should a business team do when identity boundaries are unclear?
options: Add an access check and escalate if needed
questions.explanation: Identity and access differences must be checked before the AI use case is scaled.

questions.question: Which use case most likely needs formal security review?
options: Proposal assistant using sensitive data and an external tool
questions.explanation: Sensitive data plus an external tool is a clear review trigger.

questions.question: What does an abuse case add to a security triage sheet?
options: A concrete example of how the AI workflow could be misused
questions.explanation: Abuse cases make the risk concrete enough to review and mitigate.
